title: Pocketwatch
description: Whenever you play 3 or fewer cards during your turn, draw 3 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks cards played each turn. Compares against the previous turn's count at hand draw time. Does not trigger on turn 1. Shows a counter displaying cards played this turn (displayed when in combat). Status indicator shows Active when cards played this turn ≤ 3.
